description: Save how you started one of this repo's apps for a take, so the next demo starts from it: the exact commands with placeholders, the variable NAMES it needs (never values), isolation steps, the dev sign-in path, ports, what to avoid, cleanup. Written into this repo on this machine and never sent to tday: .tday/apps/<app>.md, which the developer commits to share with their team's agents, or with keep "local" .tday/local/<app>.md, this machine only (git ignores it). Nothing is committed. It replaces that app's note, so read it first with demo_app_notes and keep what still holds. In a public repo the developer chooses where it goes (asked directly when the client supports it). Anything that looks like a secret is refused and nothing is written. Tell the developer what you saved and where.

appKey.description: A short name for the app: "web", "desktop", "cli"

body.description: The note, plain text or Markdown

keep.description: "repo": .tday/apps, to commit and share. "local": .tday/local, this machine only. In a public repo, only what the developer chose

repoDir.description: The repo (default: the current directory); its .env values are checked against the note

name: demo_app_note_save
title: Save how this app starts for a demo
